_note: Take-off stance: an extending nose strut on each front wheel raises the nose for the rolling take-off, so the wing and hull reach lifting incidence without having to rotate about the rear tyres. Found in the 11 Nov 2026 fans-off take-off investigation (docs/phantom/A10C_FANS_OFF_TAKEOFF.md). Opt-in; variants that do not list this overlay are unchanged.

nose_lift_m.s: front ride-height increase in take-off stance: 0.20 m over the 3.13 m wheelbase = 3.7 deg nose-up; chosen from plant take-off rolls (0.2 m lifts off at 74-78 m/s; 0.3 m peaks at 13 deg pitch, above the 11.9 deg tail-strike angle)

nose_lift_rate_m_s.s: Thomson Electrak HD (10 kN dynamic variant): 71 mm/s no load, 58 mm/s at maximum load; 50 mm/s used at the 4.3 kN static corner load

nose_lift_force_n.s: Thomson Electrak HD rear-mount brochure: 10,000 N maximum dynamic load, 18,000 N static; one actuator per front corner (static corner load about 4.3 kN)
